summary: Iter 16 — Verified the `done_emitted` flag fix in /app/backend/voice_stream.py that E1 added to prevent duplicate `done` emission on the happy path (real pipeline completes → real done emitted → cleanup should NOT emit synthetic done). Confirmed code shape: `done_emitted = False` at line 1186, `nonlocal done_emitted` at line 1313, `done_emitted = True` at line 1443 (after real done), cleanup guard `not done_emitted` at line 1785. Only TWO `done` emit sites in the entire file (grep-verified: lines 1442 and 1787), both properly flagged/gated. Re-ran iter15 suite → 5/5 PASS (8.05s). Wrote new iter16 suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter16_no_duplicate_done_jan2026.py with 6 tests asserting `len(done_events) == 1` after a 2.5-3s tail window post-first-done → 6/6 PASS (12.20s). Scenarios covered: (a) no-audio → exactly 1 synthetic done reason='no_audio_received', no dupe in tail; (b) tiny 200B audio → exactly 1 done, no dupe in tail; (c) ~1s 400Hz tone (4 chunks streamed) → exactly 1 done, no dupe in tail; (d) regressions: /api/profile returns Fabio (name/aria/634+msgs/onboarded/voice_locked), /api/auth/apple invalid→401, /api/auth/dev-login→200. NOTE on scenario (c): the pure-tone PCM did not transcribe as speech, so the cleanup synthetic path still fired (flavor='synthetic', reason='no_speech_detected') — the exact real-pipeline happy path could not be exercised without valid speech audio. However code inspection + grep proves the fix logic is correct: real done emit sets done_emitted=True BEFORE cleanup runs, and cleanup guard checks `not done_emitted`.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 16 verified the `done_emitted` protocol-hygiene fix. All iter15 tests still green and new iter16 tests explicitly assert `len(done_events) == 1` with a 2.5-3s tail window after the first `done` to catch any duplicate. The one remaining coverage gap is the *real* happy-path (Deepgram/Whisper transcribes → LLM/TTS pipeline runs → real done emitted → cleanup skipped via done_emitted). If a next iteration adds such a fixture, add a test that: (1) sends real speech audio, (2) waits ~20s, (3) asserts exactly one done event where done.get('no_transcript') is not True.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no new issue found. Verifying an already-applied fix. Original minor issue from iter15: cleanup block guard was only `client_alive and not pipeline_in_flight`, which becomes True (`not pipeline_in_flight`) even after a successful pipeline that already emitted `done` (because the finally-block on line 1449 resets `pipeline_in_flight = False`). This would cause a second synthetic `done` to be emitted on the happy path — a protocol-hygiene bug (client callback appeared idempotent but two `done`s were sent). Fix: added `done_emitted` boolean flag flipped True after ANY `done` emit; cleanup guard now `client_alive and not pipeline_in_flight and not done_emitted`. Verified: (a) all iter15 scenarios still pass (5/5), (b) new dedicated no-dupe assertions pass (6/6), (c) grep confirms only 2 done-emit sites in the whole file, both properly instrumented.
